records.name: Critical Upper
records.skill_description: A short-range Ki-laced uppercut that launches the opponent and leaves them airborne for follow-up attacks.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation describes a punch/uppercut Strike Super with short range and launching properties. The canonical source reports roughly 10% damage in its documented test context; that contextual damage figure is not promoted to a universal numeric database value.
records.acquisition_notes: Independent Dragon Ball documentation confirms the Future Warrior learns Critical Upper by completing Lesson 1 of Dodoria's Training. Jiren customization availability is treated separately from the canonical unlock route.
records.pve_notes: Mentor training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Short-range launching Strike Super suitable for follow-up attacks; detailed frame and matchup behavior is version-sensitive and not encoded as unsupported numeric data.
